candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old and has fever for 2 days. The temperature is 38.5°C. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious and does not vomit everything. There is no clouding of the cornea. The child has a generalized rash. Malaria risk is high in this area. Malaria test is available and the result is positive. The child has cough with measles. There are no mouth ulcers and measles has not occurred within the last 3 months. There is no obvious cause of fever identified and no identified bacterial cause of fever in this assessment. There is no pus draining from the eye, no red eyes, no runny nose, and no stiff neck. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, does not have diarrhoea, and does not have ear problem.
